newsitem.title: POLAND: Agros plans 3.4 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: Agros plans 3.4 mln share issue.

text.p: Polish food trader and producer Agros SA said it would ask its shareholders on November 22 to approve an increase in share capital by 3,425,000 shares.

Agros published on Wednesday a draft shareholders' meeting resolution raising the company's share capital to 12 million shares from 8,575,000 shares by adding a new "D" issue of 3,425,000 common shares.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment. Agros said earlier this week it planned to set a new ex-rights share issue but gave no details.
